caption: Ancient Theatre of Taormina, Taormina
composition: Floodlit Greek-Roman theatre with Etna beyond at night · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera looks across the ancient theatre from above the cavea. The lit stone rows curve down the left side of the frame, while the ruined scene building stands center-right with its great arch and broken colonnade, floodlit against the night. Beyond, the town lights scatter below and the smoking cone of Etna rises on the horizon under the 05:11 dark sky.
